script: Players who brought their country BACK TO GLORY. Argentina were once the kings of South America. In nineteen ninety-three, Gabriel Batistuta scored twice to beat Mexico two to one and win the Copa América in Ecuador, giving them their fourteenth title, and nobody thought it would be their last for a very long time. But that win was about to turn into the longest nightmare in Argentine football history. Year after year passed with nothing, and then in two thousand five, a young teen named Lionel Messi made his debut. He would go on to become the greatest player on the planet, however the trophies still didn't come. He lost the two thousand fourteen World Cup final, then reached three Copa América finals and lost every one of them. After sixteen years of Messi wearing that shirt, Argentina still had zero major trophies to show for it. But the place where that pain finally ended was the last place any Argentine ever wanted to be, and if you're enjoying the content please hit the follow button. It was two thousand twenty-one, and Argentina were facing Brazil in the Copa América final, in Brazil's own backyard. Ángel Di María lobbed the ball over the keeper in the twenty-second minute to make it one to nothing, and Argentina held on, so when the whistle blew, Messi fell to his knees and cried because twenty-eight years of pain were finally gone. He lifted a trophy for his country at last, and a year later he led them all the way to the World Cup title in Qatar.
